summary: A workflow run (table workflow_runs, migration 0015) is the server-side sequencer for ONE approved multi-step workflow: it is created once per SEQUENTIAL approval handoff when the owner claims it on /approve with a proven wallet for every namespace the workflow uses (eip155 and/or solana), binds those wallets and the canonical strategy+hash immutably, and then executes steps strictly in order, each only after the previous step is RECONCILED. Two mutually exclusive modes exist: CONFIRM_EACH_STEP, where every step is re-composed alone, re-gated, and loaded into the ordinary single-step signing surface so the owner's own wallet signs and the BROWSER submits (EVM eth_sendTransaction from the injected/FloFi provider; Solana wallet-standard signTransaction with the server broadcasting the signed bytes), after which the flow's `report`/`submit` endpoint records the hash and the run learns it by reading the flow's durable run record as the step's wallet (observe.ts); and DELEGATED, where the owner signs one EIP-712 ERC-7710 "workflow grant" per EVM chain (MetaMask Delegation Framework v1.3, EIP-7702 smart account required) and the BUILD-AUTOMATION-002 executor on the Railway worker signs `redeemDelegations` transactions from a shared KMS session EOA that pays all gas. The authorization plan (authorization-plan.ts) is a pure function of the composed workflow, the gates (mcp/execution.ts), the deployment's delegation facts and the owner's grants; it reports per-mode availability with closed reason codes (WORKFLOW_RUNS_NOT_ENABLED, DELEGATION_NOT_ENABLED, DELEGATED_SIGNER_UNAVAILABLE, WORKFLOW_GRANT_NAMESPACE_UNSUPPORTED for any Solana step, WORKFLOW_BINDING_NOT_EXACT for cross-chain or non swap/borrow producers, WORKFLOW_SLIPPAGE_UNSUPPORTED >3%, WORKFLOW_GRANT_TOO_MANY_CALLS >16, plus stepCapability codes such as DELEGATION_FRAMEWORK_NOT_DEPLOYED for Robinhood Chain, MAINNET_DELEGATION_DISABLED, DELEGATED_TARGET_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE for bridges); EVM_ACCOUNT_NOT_UPGRADED and FLOFI_WALLET_METHOD_UNSUPPORTED arise at signing time (adapters.verifyEnrollment / the Privy FloFi Wallet provider), not in the plan. Dependent amounts are typed bindings `{step, amountFrom}` on one exact asset identity; in confirm mode the runner resolves min(cap, producer.reconciled received − earlier consumers' spend) from the producer step's stored outcome (received-amounts.ts adapts each flow's record shape, including the universal bridge's destination delivery), rewrites the consumer step's strategy, and the step gets a new per-step workflow hash; in delegated mode the amount is fixed at signing to the producer's signed minimum output and never narrowed. Advancement is a deduplicated durable work item (`workflow-run.advance`) driven by `advanceRun`, which is idempotent compare-and-set over DB-trigger-enforced state machines; the worker observes and mirrors but can never make a step READY (it has no requester policy), so the owner must return to /approve (continue) to load each confirm-mode step. The HTTP surface is Next.js server actions in app/approve-action.ts over platform/approve.ts (status/continue/start/cancel/resume/review/authorize), with delegated review/sign/revoke forwarded on the remote runtime to POST /v1/delegation/:method on the Railway API. Chat surfaces (MCP get_approval_status, channels) and the Editor (EDITOR_SESSION requester, migration 0022) all converge on the same handoff → run → /approve path and read the same RunView. There is no EIP-5792, ERC-4337 UserOperation, user-signed EIP-7702, Solana signAllTransactions or durable-nonce code anywhere in the repository (grep returned only evidence JSON), the Canvas keeps a separate client-side sequence model (state/workflow-store.tsx) that is not the server run, and the run data model has no notion of execution groups, gas payer, or estimated/guaranteed/actual amount triads.

flows: REQUEST → HANDOFF (any requester). A v2 multi-step strategy is composed (composeWorkflowBound) and gated by evaluateWorkflowGates (mcp/execution.ts:199-218): workflowPlan marks it SEQUENTIAL only when every step has an owner-execution flow (128-135); confirm/delegated modes are computed per step (206-209) and delegableByCode (authorization-plan.ts:53-60) decides code-level delegability. requestApproval stores ONE PENDING mcp_handoffs row with plan.kind='SEQUENTIAL' (platform/approvals.ts, not fully read) and returns an approvalUrl with the secret in the fragment; the Editor does the same via startEditorRun (editor/approval.ts:116-136), MCP via request_user_approval (mcp/tools.ts:554), channels via their runtime (channels/runtime.ts:37).

CLAIM ON /approve → RUN CREATED. Browser proves EVM and/or Solana wallets (approval-handoff.tsx:118-121), server action claimApprovalHandoff (approve-action.ts:79-84) → claimApproval (approve.ts:148-167): requires workflowRuns surface (153) and a proven wallet for EVERY namespace of the plan (154), re-verifies the hash/policy, claims the handoff row, then claimSequential (workflow-run-approvals.ts:61-68) → ensureForClaim (service.ts:50-62) binds wallets per namespace (53) and store.create inserts workflow_runs + N PENDING steps once per handoff (pg-store.ts:82-95; UNIQUE(tenant_id,handoff_id) 0015:47). ownerAuthorizationPlan (service.ts:65-71) computes the plan with the owner's grants; if delegated is unavailable and confirm is available the run auto-starts in CONFIRM_EACH_STEP (workflow-run-approvals.ts:63-66). currentStep (service.ts:89-108) is returned as a single-step proposal (command/workflow/workflowHash) plus stepWallet (workflow-run-approvals.ts:50-58); the browser restoreWorkflow()s it into the editor (approval-handoff.tsx:218-233).

MODE CHOICE: CONFIRM. startWorkflowRunHandoff (approve-action.ts:114) → workflowRunStart (approve.ts:216) → startSequential → startConfirm (service.ts:74-81) checks plan.confirmEachStep.available then store.startConfirm (pg-store.ts:173-191): under FOR UPDATE, PENDING+mode null required, expiry checked, any non-REVOKED delegated_authorizations for the run are REVOKED (178-185), run → RUNNING/CONFIRM_EACH_STEP, MODE_CHOSEN event, advance work item enqueued (189). advanceRun then readies step 0 (runner.ts:89-136) and currentStep loads it (READY→AWAITING_OWNER with claimedAt, service.ts:102).

MODE CHOICE: DELEGATED (PR #166 path). reviewWorkflowRunAuthorization (approve-action.ts:120) → workflowRunReview (approve.ts:231) → authorizationReviewSequential (workflow-run-approvals.ts:98-106; refuses unless PENDING/mode null and plan.delegatedSingleAuthorization.available) → RunDelegationOps.review → embedded: service.workflowRunWalletReview (delegation/service.ts:516-648) / remote: delegationOperation('workflowRunWalletReview') (server/delegation-operation.ts:112-154) → POST /v1/delegation/workflowRunWalletReview (delegation/api.ts:32-54) → runDelegationOperation (operations.ts:236-241, ownedRun 217-224 requires the run's eip155 wallet among proven). The service plans exact calls per chain with fresh quotes (planWorkflowGrants, workflow-grants.ts:95-152), creates one KMS session key per chain (service.ts:553-566 signer.create), inserts PENDING_SIGNATURE grants with scope kind WORKFLOW (authority.ts:27-29) and a WALLET_WORKFLOW envelope revision (service.ts:594-596), and returns typedData per grant (616-647). Browser signOnce (workflow-run-panel.tsx:91-97) calls signWorkflowGrant per chain (delegation-browser.ts:66-77: wallet_switchEthereumChain then eth_signTypedData_v4) → authorizeWorkflowRunHandoff (approve-action.ts:122) → workflowRunAuthorize (approve.ts:240-249) → authorizeSequential (workflow-run-approvals.ts:108-120, re-checks the plan/policy) → ops.sign → service.workflowRunWalletSign (service.ts:656-697): verifies each signature via ADAPTERS.EVM_ERC7710_METAMASK_V1_3.verifyEnrollment (adapters.ts:112-131: recover signer, eth_chainId, eth_getCode == EIP-7702 designator else EVM_ACCOUNT_NOT_UPGRADED retryable, enforcer code present else DELEGATION_FRAMEWORK_NOT_DEPLOYED, not disabled), then store.activate with onActivated → activateDelegatedWithin (pg-store.ts:196-207): run → RUNNING/DELEGATED with authorization_id, all PENDING steps → DELEGATED, enqueues delegation.execute-run {workflowRunId, authorizationId} and the advance item. The approval link is marked APPLIED (approve.ts:247). A lost answer is retried idempotently (panel 101-106; service 663-665; operations 248-250).

CONFIRM MODE PER-STEP OWNER SIGNING (who submits, how the server learns the hash). After currentStep marks the step AWAITING_OWNER, the browser's apply effect (approval-handoff.tsx:199-208) calls markApprovalApplied → applyApproval SEQUENTIAL branch (approve.ts:178-185): the editor workflow must hash exactly to the AWAITING_OWNER step's workflowHash. The owner then uses the step's own flow panel/store: simulate → Review → begin (durable attempt + nonce) → handoff → the BROWSER calls provider.request('eth_sendTransaction') on the injected or FloFi provider (e.g. universal-router-store.tsx:256; also supply-store:130, uniswap-liquidity-store:159, router-store:274, lending-store:83, mode-b-store:101, public-testnet-store:288, robinhood-transfer-store:123) — the owner's wallet pays gas — and reports the hash to the flow's `report` endpoint (universal-router-store.tsx:263 universalReport {kind:'HASH', hash, attemptId}; backend/flows.ts report methods e.g. 829). (A) Transport purposes: chains.ts:21 gives the 'owner' purpose no send method on EVM, and the Railway API never submits (delegation/api.ts:9; delegation-worker.ts:21 WORKER_SUBMISSION_FORBIDDEN for flow services) — there is no server path to relay a user-signed EVM transaction or UserOperation to a bundler.

(B) Solana is second-class for single authorization: WORKFLOW_GRANT_NAMESPACE_UNSUPPORTED for any Solana step (authorization-plan.ts:98,105; workflow-grants.ts:102); Solana delegated swaps exist only in MOCKED_HARNESS (capabilities.ts:76-79, NATIVE_SOL_NOT_DELEGABLE 75; SOLANA_DELEGATED_BUILDER_NOT_IMPLEMENTED in PRODUCTION, authorization-plan.test.ts:52). (B) Cross-chain: bridges are never delegable (capabilities.ts:44-48 DELEGATED_TARGET_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE / DELEGATION_TEMPLATE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED / BRIDGE_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE) and cross-chain bindings are refused for delegated mode (WORKFLOW_BINDING_NOT_EXACT, authorization-plan.ts:94-97, workflow-grants.ts:114); confirm mode does resolve a bridge's delivered amount from the universal flow record (received-amounts.ts:139-152) and the Router (185-193), proven by confirm-run.pg.test.ts:285-333 with MOCKED flows only. There is no 'estimated / guaranteed / actual' triad: BoundResolution stores cap/received/used (pg-store.ts:21-23); the plan exposes only RECONCILED_RECEIVED_AMOUNT vs SIGNED_GUARANTEED_MINIMUM labels (authorization-plan.ts:44-46).

(B) Binding language: dependencies are `{step, amountFrom}` on exactly one asset identity that the consumer spends and the producer delivers (workflow-bindings.ts:23,86-107); there is no `previous.output.amount`-style reference, no multi-output producers, and add_liquidity consumers bind one maxAmounts key (28,53-59). Step count is capped at 2..8 (0015:34, current_step ≤7).

(B) Chat vs Canvas parity: the Canvas keeps its own client-side sequence model (state/workflow-store.tsx:80-114, 204-217) with completions persisted in localStorage and re-proven only against public/supply/solana-swap statuses (123-126, 229-243); this is NOT the server workflow_runs record. The Editor reaches the server run only by handing off (editor/approval.ts:116-136 → /approve), after which the run's strategy/hash are immutable (0015:66) and any re-composition drift is WORKFLOW_RUN_STALE (service.ts:67; runner.ts:92) — unexecuted steps cannot be edited in place on a server run.

(B) Worker cannot progress confirm-mode steps: policyFor is null on the worker (worker.ts:46; runner.ts:34-37,123-124), so each step becomes READY only when the owner continues in the web tier (service.ts:92) — incompatible with 'pre-signed delayed steps' unless the requester policy is bound into the run at claim.

(C) Interaction counting is coarse: confirm mode reports walletConfirmationsAtLeast = steps.length (authorization-plan.ts:116) ignoring per-step token approvals (a note only, 6-7) and chain switches; delegated reports walletSignatures = max(1, enrollments.length) (117) and does not count the one-time EIP-7702 upgrade (enrollment.active is always null, 40,90) nor the wallet_switchEthereumChain prompts (delegation-browser.ts:72-75). No per-chain upfront collection exists for confirm mode; Solana never has an upfront authorization.

(C) No execution groups: steps run strictly one after another (runner.ts:93) and each confirm-mode step is a full simulate→Review→sign→submit cycle of its own flow (runner.ts:6-12; confirm-run.pg.test.ts:79-115); independent same-chain steps cannot be batched into one wallet interaction.

Mode is global per run (authorization-plan.ts:16 'modes are never mixed'; 0015:53-54), so a workflow with EVM (delegable) + Solana steps falls entirely to confirm mode (delegated-run.pg.test.ts:146-158).

Evidence levels for delegated steps are MOCKED|PUBLIC_UNVERIFIED only (runner.ts:184); owner-run outcomes carry the flow's evidence environment (observe.ts:61). risks: Changing who submits delegated steps touches the executor nonce bookkeeping (sessionNextNonce executor.ts:342; evmNextNonce; fillStaleNonces drivers.ts:134-150) and the SUBMISSION_PREPARED recovery contract (executor.ts:359-375) that assumes persisted raw bytes signed by the session key; a user-funded path cannot reuse this recovery without a new persisted artifact type.

The confirm-mode observation window keys on claimed_at and an exact per-step semantic hash (observe.ts:43-56); any batch or pre-signed strategy that submits several steps from one interaction breaks the one-run-per-step, created-after-claim assumption and the duplicate-run reporting (74).

DB triggers freeze a step's strategy/hash/bound once written (0015:121-124) and the run's strategy forever (66); 'edit unexecuted steps' on a server run requires a new run or a new mutable projection, not an UPDATE.

Cancellation refuses while any step is AWAITING_OWNER/UNCERTAIN/DELEGATED (canEndWorkflow); pre-signed but not yet broadcast steps would need a new 'maybe submitted' classification (MAYBE_SUBMITTED state-machine.ts:44) or they can be neither cancelled nor safely resumed.

Delegated grants are valid ≤1 h (workflow-grants.ts:37) while confirm runs live 7 days (state-machine.ts:47); mixing per-chain strategies in one run needs a unified expiry/attention model, and the runner's `expiresAt` checks (runner.ts:82,94,139) assume one window.

The worker never readies steps (policy unknown), so any server-driven submission of user pre-signed transactions after a cross-chain wait must carry the requester policy durably or be refused; today's defense is explicit (runner.ts:34-37).

Amount binding correctness depends on the per-flow record adapters (received-amounts.ts) that match on asset keys; a new chain/flow without an adapter silently yields no received amount → WORKFLOW_BINDING_NOTHING_RECEIVED (runner.ts:118) and halts the run.

Remote-runtime delegated operations traverse Vercel BFF → Railway API with DELEGATION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN handling (server/delegation-operation.ts:130-143); new operations must keep the idempotent-retry contract (service.ts:663-665; operations.ts:248-250) or lost answers will double-activate.
FloFi Wallet (Privy) cannot sign typed data or 7702 authorizations; building 4337/7702 UserOps for it is blocked at the signer boundary (flofi-privy-signer.ts:75), not in the run layer.

The Canvas sequence store (workflow-store.tsx) and the server run can disagree after a refresh (localStorage pointers re-proven only for three runtimes, 123-126); unifying them changes core editor state semantics (runtimeWorkflow 212).
